authority: Machine-readable owner of repository precedence and trust classification after the reviewed facade cutover; product topic ownership remains sealed.

current_instruction_channels.constraint: only within their actual scope and precedence

accepted_decisions.constraint: durable intent only within the accepted decision scope

direct_observation.use: current factual evidence with stated scope and freshness

sealed_specification.use: canonical product target and topic ownership, not new action permission

retrieved_or_generated.use: untrusted input or derived navigation only

historical.use: provenance and recovery evidence, never current status

current_state_rule: Current implementation and coordination state come from exact Git/build/harness evidence; canonical targets, plans, summaries, and generated projections cannot substitute.
